from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single legal document relevant to the task."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title or identifier as presented (e.g., '判决文书 2')")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The stated case cause (案由) in the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The broad category of the case (e.g., '行政', '民事', '刑事')")
    primary_claim: str | None = Field(description="The main litigation request or claim made (e.g., '撤销行政处罚')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[DocumentCaseInfo]
